name: Short-Stay Visa (Visa C) / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of EU member states, Schengen signatories, and several associated countries (Andorra, Montenegro, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Serbia, Switzerland) may enter with just an ID card and, along with other visa-exempt nationalities, may stay up to 90 days within any 180-day period; anyone staying more than 3 days must register their presence within 48 hours of arrival. Non-exempt nationalities need a Visa C (short-stay, for tourism, family visits, business, sport, judicial matters, or education; processing up to 30 days) or a Visa D (long-stay, for family reunification or employment, capped at 180 days within one year). UAE nationals get a full 90-day exemption; Bahrain lost its exemption on 1 September 2023 and now needs a visa.
requirements.fix_path: For non-exempt nationalities, apply for a Visa C at a Bosnian diplomatic mission before travel.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid for the stay (or ID card for exempt EU/associated nationals)
Registration of presence within 48 hours (stays over 3 days)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period (Visa C / visa-exempt); up to 180 days within one year (Visa D)

sources.title: Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Abu Dhabi (official diplomatic mission) -- visa-free nationalities, ID-card entry for EU/associated countries, Visa C/D categories and durations
